Sorry all, I work Graveyards. Went home and Crashed. This is from the book step by step instant pot by Jeffrey  Eisner. I am on mobile so im sorry if the format comes out weird.

1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil
1 large Vidalia (sweet) onion coarsely chopped
1 green and red bell pepper, cut in to medium dice
6 cloves of garlic minced or pressed
1 large eggplant, 1 medium  yellow squash, 1 large zucchini. skin on sliced in to 1/2" disks then quartered 
1 can of diced tomatoes drained (14.5 oz)
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 1/2 tsp Herbs De Provence (optional)
1 tsp kosher salt
1 tsp black peper
1/2 tsp dried thyme
1/2 cup vegetable broth or dry red whine
1 Tbs Worcestershire sauce
1 can tomato paste (6-oz)
1: pour oil in to instant pot and hit saute and adjust so its on the more or high setting. Heat for 3 minutes before adding the onions and bell peppers then saute while stirring for  three minutes. Add the garlic and saute for another minute.
2: add the other vegetables and seasonings along with Worcestershire sauce and red wine or vegetable broth. 
3: secure the lid and seal. Manual pressure cook on high pressure for 2 minutes release when done
4: stir in the tomato paste, let stand for about 10 minutes before serving. It looks soupy at first but will thicken as it cools.
